review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines `linearYoneda` and `linearCoyoneda`, which are R-linear (ModuleCat-valued) versions of Mathlib's `yoneda`/`coyoneda` and of `preadditiveYoneda`/`preadditiveCoyoneda` (AddCommGrpCat-valued). These are different concepts: they land in a different target category. The file ties them to the existing ones with the `whiskering_*` rfl lemmas and derives Full/Faithful from the existing `Yoneda.yoneda_full` and `Coyoneda.coyoneda_full`. I grepped Mathlib for other linear Yoneda constructions and found only uses of these definitions, for example in ModuleCat/Monoidal/Closed.lean, ext, and group cohomology. I found no competing ModuleCat-valued Yoneda definition elsewhere. I did not search exhaustively for under-named alternatives such as a generic Hom-functor into ModuleCat. I found no justified duplication.
